strict_gold: In this work, we focus on the dynamics of discussions between reviewers and investigate the presence of herding behaviour therein.

Specifically, we aim to understand whether reviewers and discussion chairs get disproportionately influenced by the first argument presented in the discussion when (in case of reviewers) they form an independent opinion about the paper before discussing it with others.
acceptable_alternatives: In conjunction with the review process of a large, top tier machine learning conference, we design and execute a randomized controlled trial that involves 1,544 papers and 2,797 reviewers with the goal of testing for the conditional causal effect of the discussion initiator’s opinion on the outcome of a paper.
roles.selected_quote: Our experiment reveals no evidence of herding in peer-review discussions.
